_note: The 30 second product demo. Account numbers are the sample account (labelled Sample account in frame). Hook lines and the end card CTA are swapped per row by scripts/batch.mjs with batches/demo-hooks.csv.

scenes.caption: i hired an ai to manage my amazon ads. it asks before it touches anything.
you connect seller central and ads once, with amazon's own sign-in.
every morning it finds what to fix, ranked by money. a few clear jobs.
you tap approve. it makes the change in amazon.
or reply yes from your messages. that's the whole workflow.
a week later it checks if it worked.
seven day money back. link in bio.
